meta.title: Silberberg — Gold & Silver Buying in Koper
meta.description: Discreet gold, silver and jewellery buying in Koper. Appraisal in front of you, immediate payment, no obligation.

hero.heading: Gold and silver buying in Koper
hero.sub: Jewellery, coins, bars, dental gold. Weighed and assessed in front of you — accept or decline the offer, and be paid on the spot.
hero.point1: Appraisal is free and carries no obligation
hero.point2: Weighing and testing in front of you

pricing.heading: Indicative prices by fineness
pricing.lead: The final price is set at appraisal, based on the day's market rate and the weight and fineness of your items.
pricing.disclaimer: Prices are indicative and change regularly. Call or visit for today's exact rate.

how.heading: From item to payment in four steps
how.step1Text: Walk in or book a time. Bring damaged or unmarked jewellery too — we determine the fineness ourselves.
how.step2Text: Items are weighed on a calibrated scale and tested for fineness. You see every step, and we explain it as we go.
how.step3Text: We name an exact figure. Take your time to decide — the offer commits you to nothing.
how.step4Text: Accept the offer and you are paid on the spot.

buy.heading: We buy gold and silver in every form
buy.jewelryDesc: Chains, rings, bracelets, earrings — damaged or unpaired included.
buy.coinsDesc: Gold and silver coins, commemorative and bullion.
buy.barsDesc: Investment bars of any size, with or without certificate.
buy.dentalDesc: Crowns and bridges, cleaned or not.
buy.watchesDesc: Gold and silver watches and cases.
buy.scrapDesc: Broken, unpaired or old jewellery — weight and fineness set the value.
buy.exclusionsNote: Category list and exclusions to be confirmed with the client.

trust.heading: Everything happens in front of you
trust.appraisalText: We weigh on a calibrated scale and test fineness in front of you. Every figure on the offer can be explained.
trust.discretionText: Appraisals are private, with no audience and no records passed to anyone. What you bring, and what we agree, stays between us.
trust.licenseText: Business registration details and VAT ID will be published before launch.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Items are weighed on a calibrated scale and tested for fineness. Everything happens in front of you, and we explain the process as we go. Appraisal is free and takes a few minutes.
faq.q2: How much is my gold worth?
faq.a2: Weight, fineness and the day's market rate set the value. Published prices are indicative — for an exact figure, bring your items in for a free appraisal or call us.
faq.a3: Yes. The law requires seller identification when precious metals are bought. Your details are kept as regulations require and are not passed to third parties.
faq.q4: Do you buy damaged or old jewellery?
faq.a4: Yes. Scratches, broken chains or a missing pair don't reduce the metal's value — that is set by weight and fineness.
faq.a5: Immediately, as soon as you accept the offer.
faq.q6: Do you buy silver as well?
faq.a6: Yes — silver jewellery, coins, bars and tableware in 925 and 999 fineness.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Silberberg
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data this site collects and how it is handled.
privacy.controllerText: Controller details (full company name, address, contact) will be published before launch.
privacy.collectText: Through the contact form we collect your name, email or phone number, and the content of your message. The site sets no tracking cookies; choosing a language manually stores a single functional cookie with that preference.
privacy.purposeText: Your details are used solely to answer your enquiry. They are not shared with third parties and not used for advertising.
privacy.retentionText: Enquiries are kept no longer than needed to handle them, then deleted. Exact periods will be set before launch.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time, and may lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner.
